gates.title: Existing hub entry router
guardrails: choose an existing hub or section checkpoint before creating any new hub
route low-density axes through section-low-density-hub-path-exposure-2026-05-07
do not promote this gate into graph/data, catalogs, README, or landing surfaces in this lane

gates.title: Low-density hub/path exposure checkpoint

only use existing root markdown route, walkthrough, checklist, FAQ, and source notes

gates.title: GitHub Pages live docs verification checkpoint

live check is read-only: confirm docs/index.html exposes gates.json, existing-hub router, low-density section, and coverage links

compare live HTML labels against local docs/index.html and docs/gates.json targets; HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient evidence
live comparison guardrail: status 200 with stale/mismatched title must be recorded as WAIT/live-local mismatch, not PASS or completed exposure

lastLiveCheck.guardrail: Third WAIT evidence: HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient; expected route title is absent while the gateway title is present, so keep Pages reflection classified as WAIT-3, not PASS. Repeated WAIT-to-FAIL escalation belongs to the main/process owner.

evidence bundle must separate request original, public/confirmed source, owner confirmation, audit-info hold, and excluded personal, investigation, disciplinary, security, or strategy material

submission/follow-up tracking checklist records requester, deadline, submitted bundle, open confirmation, disposition/follow-up owner, evidence of completion, and next check without exposing private details

public/private/audit-info boundary must stop audit technique, finding strategy, witness or complainant identifiers, disciplinary/investigation/security details, and internal response strategy before external sharing
keep exposure limited to docs/index.html, docs/gates.json, and root section/coverage/quality/manifest markdown
